        AND ("model_catalog"."thinking_default" IS NULL OR "model_catalog"."thinking_default" IN ('off', 'low', 'medium', 'high')) AND ("model_catalog"."thinking_max" IS NULL OR "model_catalog"."thinking_max" IN ('off', 'low', 'medium', 'high'))
        AND "model_catalog"."thinking_lowest" IN ('off', 'low')

model_catalog_thinking_shape.name: model_catalog_thinking_shape
model_catalog_thinking_shape.value:
CASE WHEN "model_catalog"."thinking_control" = 'none'
          THEN NOT "model_catalog"."thinking_allowed" AND "model_catalog"."thinking_default" IS NULL AND "model_catalog"."thinking_max" IS NULL
            AND "model_catalog"."thinking_lowest" = 'off'
        WHEN NOT "model_catalog"."reasoning" THEN false
        WHEN "model_catalog"."thinking_control" IN ('anthropic_effort')
          AND "model_catalog"."thinking_lowest" <> 'low' THEN false
        WHEN NOT "model_catalog"."thinking_allowed"
          THEN "model_catalog"."thinking_lowest" = 'off'
            AND "model_catalog"."thinking_default" IS NULL AND "model_catalog"."thinking_max" IS NULL
        ELSE "model_catalog"."thinking_default" IS NOT NULL AND "model_catalog"."thinking_max" IS NOT NULL
          AND "model_catalog"."thinking_max" <> 'off'
          AND array_position(ARRAY['off', 'low', 'medium', 'high']::text[], "model_catalog"."thinking_default") <= array_position(ARRAY['off', 'low', 'medium', 'high']::text[], "model_catalog"."thinking_max")
          AND array_position(ARRAY['off', 'low', 'medium', 'high']::text[], "model_catalog"."thinking_lowest") <= array_position(ARRAY['off', 'low', 'medium', 'high']::text[], "model_catalog"."thinking_default")
        END

skill_drafts_provenance.name: skill_drafts_provenance
skill_drafts_provenance.value: ("skill_drafts"."started_from" = 'thread') = ("skill_drafts"."from_thread_id" IS NOT NULL) AND ("skill_drafts"."started_from" = 'fork') = ("skill_drafts"."parent_ref" IS NOT NULL)

skill_eval_results_done.name: skill_eval_results_done
skill_eval_results_done.value:
("skill_eval_results"."execution" IS NOT NULL) = ("skill_eval_results"."state" = 'done')
        AND ("skill_eval_results"."finished_at" IS NOT NULL) = ("skill_eval_results"."state" = 'done')

skill_eval_results_json.name: skill_eval_results_json
skill_eval_results_json.value:
("skill_eval_results"."execution" IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof("skill_eval_results"."execution") = 'object')
        AND ("skill_eval_results"."first_attempt" IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof("skill_eval_results"."first_attempt") = 'object')
        AND ("skill_eval_results"."first_attempt" IS NULL OR "skill_eval_results"."attempt" = 2)

skill_eval_runs_keys.name: skill_eval_runs_keys
skill_eval_runs_keys.value:
char_length("skill_eval_runs"."bundle_key") BETWEEN 1 AND 512 AND "skill_eval_runs"."bundle_size" > 0
        AND ("skill_eval_runs"."fixtures_key" IS NULL OR char_length("skill_eval_runs"."fixtures_key") BETWEEN 1 AND 512)

skill_eval_runs_json.name: skill_eval_runs_json
skill_eval_runs_json.value:
jsonb_typeof("skill_eval_runs"."suite") = 'object' AND jsonb_typeof("skill_eval_runs"."limits") = 'object'
        AND ("skill_eval_runs"."run_model" IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof("skill_eval_runs"."run_model") = 'object')
        AND ("skill_eval_runs"."judge_model" IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof("skill_eval_runs"."judge_model") = 'object')
        AND ("skill_eval_runs"."scorecard" IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof("skill_eval_runs"."scorecard") = 'object')
        AND ("skill_eval_runs"."failure" IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof("skill_eval_runs"."failure") = 'object')

skill_eval_runs_outcome.name: skill_eval_runs_outcome
skill_eval_runs_outcome.value:
("skill_eval_runs"."scorecard" IS NOT NULL) = ("skill_eval_runs"."status" = 'completed')
        AND ("skill_eval_runs"."failure" IS NOT NULL) = ("skill_eval_runs"."status" IN ('failed', 'budget_stopped'))
        AND ("skill_eval_runs"."finished_at" IS NOT NULL) = ("skill_eval_runs"."status" IN ('completed', 'failed', 'cancelled', 'budget_stopped'))

skill_promotion_requests_decision.name: skill_promotion_requests_decision
skill_promotion_requests_decision.value:
("skill_promotion_requests"."state" = 'pending') = ("skill_promotion_requests"."decided_at" IS NULL)
        AND ("skill_promotion_requests"."decided_at" IS NULL) = ("skill_promotion_requests"."decided_by" IS NULL)
        AND ("skill_promotion_requests"."state" = 'confirmed') = ("skill_promotion_requests"."registry_version_id" IS NOT NULL)

thread_app_results_stored.name: thread_app_results_stored
thread_app_results_stored.value:
("thread_app_results"."storage" = 'inline') = ("thread_app_results"."result" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("thread_app_results"."storage" = 'blob') = ("thread_app_results"."blob_ref" IS NOT NULL)

thread_app_results_origin.name: thread_app_results_origin
thread_app_results_origin.value:
NOT ("thread_app_results"."entry_id" IS NOT NULL AND "thread_app_results"."tool_call_id" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("thread_app_results"."entry_id" IS NOT NULL OR "thread_app_results"."tool_call_id" IS NOT NULL
          OR ("thread_app_results"."run_id" IS NOT NULL AND "thread_app_results"."pi_name" IS NOT NULL AND "thread_app_results"."input_sha256" IS NOT NULL))

thread_app_results_queued.name: thread_app_results_queued
thread_app_results_queued.value:
("thread_app_results"."queued_at" IS NULL OR ("thread_app_results"."entry_id" IS NOT NULL AND "thread_app_results"."card_text" IS NOT NULL))
        AND ("thread_app_results"."card_text" IS NULL OR char_length("thread_app_results"."card_text") <= 16384)
        AND ("thread_app_results"."opened_by" IS NULL OR "thread_app_results"."entry_id" IS NOT NULL)

workspace_sync_conflicts_run_thread.name: workspace_sync_conflicts_run_thread
workspace_sync_conflicts_run_thread.value: "workspace_sync_conflicts"."run_id" IS NULL OR "workspace_sync_conflicts"."thread_id" IS NOT NULL

site_branding_assets_size.name: site_branding_assets_size
site_branding_assets_size.value: "site_branding_assets"."byte_size" = octet_length("site_branding_assets"."bytes") AND "site_branding_assets"."byte_size" > 0 AND "site_branding_assets"."byte_size" <= CASE WHEN "site_branding_assets"."kind" = 'favicon' THEN 262144 ELSE 524288 END

site_branding_assets_dimensions.name: site_branding_assets_dimensions
site_branding_assets_dimensions.value: ("site_branding_assets"."width" IS NULL OR "site_branding_assets"."width" BETWEEN 1 AND 4096) AND ("site_branding_assets"."height" IS NULL OR "site_branding_assets"."height" BETWEEN 1 AND 4096)

site_branding_assets_content_type.name: site_branding_assets_content_type
site_branding_assets_content_type.value: CASE WHEN "site_branding_assets"."kind" = 'favicon' THEN "site_branding_assets"."content_type" IN ('image/png', 'image/svg+xml', 'image/x-icon') ELSE "site_branding_assets"."content_type" IN ('image/png', 'image/jpeg', 'image/webp', 'image/svg+xml') END
